text: tracker worktree breaks when the repository directory is moved

Investigation (host repo moved from /a/host to /b/host):
- .git/gittoc/.git is a gitfile: "gitdir: /a/host/.git/worktrees/gittoc" (stale)
- .git/worktrees/gittoc/gitdir contains "/a/host/.git/gittoc/.git" (stale)
- Every command fails: "fatal: not a git repository: /a/host/.git/worktrees/gittoc"
- `git worktree repair` with no arguments does NOT help: git uses the admin gitdir file to find linked worktrees, and that file points at the old path.
- `git worktree repair .git/gittoc` run from the main repo fixes both files ("gitdir incorrect" + ".git file broken") and gittoc works again.

Proposal: in Tracker._ensure_worktree, after is_worktree(checkout) is true, probe `git -C <checkout> rev-parse --git-dir` with check=False. If it fails, run `git worktree repair <checkout>` from the repo root, print one stderr line ("repaired tracker worktree link after repository move"), and re-probe; if still broken, exit with a message naming the manual command. One extra git call only on the failure path; the happy path is unchanged. Test: init, move the temp repo with shutil.move, run `summary`, expect success plus the notice.
